questions.question: Value of (tan 1° tan2° tan3°...... tan 89°) is (tan 1° tan2° tan3°...... tan 89°) का मान क्या है?
questions.questionHtml:
Value of (tan 1° tan2° tan3°...... tan 89°) is

(tan 1° tan2° tan3°...... tan 89°) का मान क्या है?
questions.solution:
tan1° tan2° tan3°..... tan89°

= tan (90° - 89° ) tan(90° - 88° )..... tan 88° tan 89°

= cot 89° cot 88° ... tan 45°... tan 88° tan 89°

Since cot 89 = 1/tan 89, cot 89 x tan 89 = 1.

Similarly, cot 88 x tan 2 = 1, .. cot 46 x tan 44 = 1

So, the product = 1 x tan 45 = 1

questions.questionHtml:
If sec63° = p, find the value of

(1/sec227°) + cos263° + cot227° - (1/(cos227°*cosec263°))

यदि sec63° = p, तो

(1/sec227°) + cos263° + cot227° - (1/(cos227°*cosec263°)) का मान ज्ञात करें|
questions.solution:
(1/sec227°) + cos263° + cot227° - (1/(cos227°*cosec263°))

= cos227° + cos263° + cot227° - sin263°/cos227°

= sin263° + cos263° + tan263° - sin263°/sin263°

= 1 + tan263° - 1 = tan263° = sec263° - 1 = p2 - 1
